name: attraction-youtube-system
description: PLUGIN 6 — the Long-Form Authority Engine for agent attraction (Week 5). One-sitting setup: channel → Game Plan → board → the Monday Kickoff → your first video, scripted in full. The four pillars every channel shares: your niche, helping struggling and new agents succeed, brokerage model breakdowns, agent interviews. Your first three videos: your blueprint (your most-searched topic), why you joined your brokerage, an interview with someone successful in your upline, downline or brokerage. ONE video a week, in full: the scripted hook with its bullet breakdown and the full 8–12 minute teleprompter script; an interview week is a question list. No trailer, no reference videos, no competitor videos. Two CTAs on every video: the guide (comment GUIDE) and the call in Mike's law's shape. Your Notion board's YouTube tab: the next 30 days, a publish checklist on every card. One draft-only workflow with your one Yes: the Monday Kickoff, the monthly review inside it. Requires Plugin 1.
